plugins.name: nys-workers-comp-hub
plugins.description: New York State workers' compensation in Claude: calculators, rates, forms, the glossary and explainers, case law, a NYC doctor finder, eleven free skills, sending cases to your Comp Desk Pro Workspace, and posting your hearing notes into your case-management system. In Claude Code it also adds The Comp Desk suite: a desk beside the chat with drafts for your review and every Hub figure with its inputs.
